_approach: A more syncopated tamborzão voicing pushed by heavier swing (0.18): the backbeat clap stays on 2 and 4 but the kick adds a second offbeat push before beat 1 of bar 2, congas trade call-and-response with the atabaque toms, and the tamborim doubles into steady 8ths. Sources describe extra snare/clap and kick hits placed between the main beats to build the pumping syncopation that defines the rhythm.
